user.title: Swiss Hail Protection
user.description: Choose where the hail signal comes from. The VKF signal needs a device registered with the cantonal building insurers and warns about 20 minutes ahead; the MeteoSwiss hail radar is open data for any location in Switzerland and shows where hail is right now.

menu_options.meteoswiss: MeteoSwiss hail radar (open data, any location)

vkf.title: VKF hail-warning signal
vkf.description: Connects to the VKF service «Hagelschutz – einfach automatisch». You need a device registered with the VKF: the device serial (deviceId) and the interface id (hwtypeId) from your registration documents or your account at meteo.netitservices.com. The service is polled once to verify them.

data_description.device_id: 12 characters, letters and digits – the MAC address of a VKF signal box or the identifier issued for your building control system.
data_description.hwtype_id: Whole number as stated on your VKF interface sheet.

meteoswiss.title: MeteoSwiss hail radar
meteoswiss.description: Evaluates the MeteoSwiss hail radar products (probability of hail and expected hail size, 1 km grid, every 5 minutes) around a location. Latitude and longitude default to your Home Assistant home location and never leave your instance: one file covers all of Switzerland. The alarm switches on when the probability of hail within the radius reaches the threshold.

data_description.radius_km: Hail within this distance of the location raises the alarm. A larger radius gives more lead time but more false alarms from cells that pass by.
data_description.poh_threshold: Probability of hail (POH) at which a radar cell counts as hail. 80 % is a good starting point.

reauth_confirm.title: Device no longer recognised
reauth_confirm.description: The VKF hail-warning service no longer recognises the configured device serial. Enter the current serial and interface id.

reconfigure.title: Change device
reconfigure.description: Change the device serial or the interface id. The service is polled once to verify them.

reconfigure_meteoswiss.title: Change location or thresholds
reconfigure_meteoswiss.description: Change the location, the radius or the alarm threshold. The latest radar product is fetched once to verify the location.

error.cannot_connect: The data service could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.device_not_found: The service does not know this device serial / interface id combination. Check both values against your VKF registration.
error.invalid_device_id: Enter the device serial as letters and digits only.
error.too_many_polls: The service refused the request because the daily poll quota of this device is exhausted. Try again later.
error.invalid_radius: Enter a radius between 1 and 50 km.
error.outside_coverage: This location lies outside the Swiss radar composite. The hail radar covers Switzerland and its immediate surroundings.
error.no_data: MeteoSwiss has not published a hail product for the last 20 minutes. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unknown: The service gave an unexpected answer. Check the Home Assistant log and try again.

abort.already_configured: This device or location is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The device was updated and the integration reloaded.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The entry was updated and the integration reloaded.
